description:
Aggregate and browse AI coding agent sessions (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.) in one place. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.

Codeg (Code Generation) is an enterprise-grade multi-agent coding workspace. It unifies local AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, OpenClaw, Cline, etc.) in a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container — enabling remote development from any browser — with conversation aggregation, parallel git worktree development, MCP/Skills management, chat channel interactions (Telegram, Lark, iLink, etc.), and integrated Git/file/terminal workflows.
This one lets agents draw charts in their reply cards, and makes Generative UI a skill you enable for each agent, now named ui-render.
Alongside that: cards in replies lose their shadow, and pressing Refresh on a Skill Packs tab no longer brings back an error or an older list.
New
- Agents can draw charts in their reply cards: ask an agent with UI Render enabled to show something as a chart, and you get area, bar, line, pie or donut, radar, radial or scatter charts in your theme's colors, with values shown on hover.
Improved
- Generative UI is now enabled per agent: Settings → Skill Packs → UI lists the UI Render skill in the same agent table as the Experts tab, so you can enable it for one agent, a few or all of them.
- Cards in replies no longer cast a shadow, so they sit flat in the message like the rest of the conversation.
Fixed
- A Skill Packs tab no longer swaps its list for an error or older data when you press Refresh while it is still loading, on the Experts, Science, Office Tools and Custom tabs alike.
- Import from agent on the Custom tab of Skill Packs no longer lists codeg's own Generative UI skill, just as it already leaves out the other skill packs.
Note
- The json-render skill is now called ui-render: start a message with /ui-render ($ui-render in Codex), and if you had Generative UI on in 0.35.0, the agents that already had json-render get ui-render in its place when you upgrade.
- The "Generative UI (json-render)" switch is gone: cards in replies always render, an agent gets UI Render in conversations started after you enable it, and the cards it already drew stay after you disable it again.
